jobs.title: Employee Experience Specialist- Part Time
jobs.companyDescription: מספקת נתונים על תעבורת אתרים ואפליקציות לצורך מחקר שוק וניתוח מתחרים.
jobs.summary: Oversee the employee journey, addressing both professional and personal aspects to ensure a well-rounded and fulfilling experience, including full employee lifecycle management (from onboarding to offboarding). jobs.requirements: At least 1 year of relevant experience as an Employee Experience Specialist and/or HR Administrator – advantage for experience in the high-tech industry. Flexibility and the ability to work in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and demanding environment.
jobs.workCondition: This position is part-time (50%) and requires on-site presence 5 days a week in half-day shifts.
jobs.match: כותרת המשרה תואמת לתחום חוויית עובד, מעורבות עובדים ותפעול (75 נקודות) והמיקום במרכז (10 נקודות).
